lines.text: Rutilated quartz's golden needles aren't gold.
lines.say: ROO-tuh-LAY-tid quartz's golden needles aren't gold.

lines.text: It is clear quartz with fine hair like needles of rutile.
lines.say: It is clear quartz with fine hair like needles of ROO-teel.

lines.text: Rutile is titanium dioxide, so the golden needles are not gold.
lines.say: ROO-teel is ty-TAY-nee-um dy-OK-side, so the golden needles are not gold.

lines.text: Titanium dioxide is also the white pigment used in paint.
Rutile gets its name from the Latin word rutilus, meaning red.
lines.say: ROO-teel gets its name from the Latin word ROO-tih-lus, meaning red.

lines.text: The needles are usually golden, and some are silvery or copper red.
Some sellers call it Venus hair stone or angel hair quartz.
Some needles cross to form a six rayed star inside the quartz.
Brazil, including the state of Bahia, is the main source.
lines.say: Brazil, including the state of bah-EE-uh, is the main source.

lines.text: Rutile is a bit softer than quartz, at 6 to 6.5.
lines.say: Rutile is a bit softer than quartz, at six to six and a half on the MOHZ scale.
